issue.title: quarkus-resteasy-mutiny Multi documentation
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
I think the documentation is not very cleared on the fact that using Multi as a return type for jax-rs resources will be blocking if `@Produces` annotation does not use `text/event-stream`. Depending on the Multi producer, that can result in never ending requests (thus, I think, the issue #13988)

**Expected behavior**
Documentation should be clear on the fact that Multi ressource are blocking.

issue.title: Mutiny subscription is not cancelled when grpc client is cancelled

labels.name: kind/bug-thirdparty
labels.description: Bugs that are caused by third-party components and not causing a major dysfunction of core Quarkus.

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Having a grpc service which returns Multi<T> and grpc client which is cancelled after some time, grpc service continue to produce items (looks similar to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/13988)


```    @Override
    public Multi<GreetingResponse> greeting(Empty request) {
        return Multi.createFrom().ticks().every(
                Duration.ofSeconds(2)).invoke(x -> {
            System.out.println(Thread.currentThread().getName() + "-" + Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
        })
                .onItem().transform(x -> GreetingResponse.newBuilder().setId(x).build());
    }
```
### Expected behavior

Grpc service is cancelled 

### Actual behavior

Grpc service continue to produce messages

### How to Reproduce?

_No response_

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

22.04.2-Ubuntu

### Output of `java -version`

Temurin-21.0.2+13

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.11.0

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Gradle 8.6

### Additional information

_No response_
